blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines— Kaila Napolis emerged as the lone podium finisher for the Philippine national jiu jitsu team on Friday after winning bronze in the women’s -52kg division at the Asian Games 2026 at Aichi Prefectural Martial Arts Hall. Napolis, a gold medalist in the 2023 Southeast Asian Games, outlasted Mongolia’s Tsagaanbileg Altangerel, 2-0, in the bronze-medal match to give the Philippines its only jiu jitsu medal on Day 2 of the competition. “It’s an honor pa rin to win a bronze medal here in a big competition.
